description: See who viewed one of your active stories. (Requires INSSIST PRO.)

cursor.description: Resume token from a previous call's nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

instant.description: Optional. Skip INSSIST's action pacing and run now — use only when the user asked for an unspaced or burst action.

storyId.description: Story media id, from ig_fetch_stories. Must be one of your own active stories.
